name: Futanari Elf Kairaku Choukyou  "Dame! Deruuu! Kore Ijou Dashitakunaiiiiii"
original_name: ふたなりエルフ快楽調教 「だめっ でるううぅっ これ以上出したくないいいぃぃ」
source:
News arrives from a remote corner of the kingdom: “Strange monsters, unlike anything we’ve ever seen, rule the roost there.” 
Frena, a skilled hunter sent to investigate, never returns. 
At first, the kingdom remains optimistic, but as the monsters—led by a witch—draw closer to the capital, the queen’s daughter and leader of the royal knight order, Cecil, sets out to deal with them. 

However, the news that reaches the queen isn’t of victory—it’s of Frena and Cecil, now futanari, driven mad with pleasure and disgraced for everyone to see!..

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/hobe_0287//]dmm[/url]]
translation:
消息从王国的一个偏远角落传来：“奇怪的怪物，与我们见过的任何东西都不一样，统治着那里。” 
弗雷娜（Frena）是一位技艺高超的猎人，被派去调查，却再也没有回来。
起初，王国仍保持乐观态度，但随着由女巫领导的怪物逼近首都，女王的女儿兼皇家骑士团领袖塞西尔开始着手对付它们。

然而，女王收到的消息并不是胜利——而是弗雷娜和塞西尔，现在是扶他，高兴得发疯，所有人都看到了耻辱！

[译自[url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/hobe_0287//]dmm[/url]]
